Name: White Cat
Author: frozenfarmer
Description:
[font=Times New Roman][size=6]White Cat Mod[/size]
[size=2]Please know that I will only upload mods on Nexus and certain certified places and not any other unreliable sites.
[/size]
[/font][size=4]This mod turns your default orange and red tabby cat into a white cat.  It's simple but the result is pretty cute.  Please feel free to leave comments, recommendations and advice in any of the discussion and chat tabs!  Thank you for installing!

[/size]

[font=Times New Roman][b][size=4]Instructions for Installation:[/size]
[/b][/font][size=4]1.) Navigate to your Stardew Valley content folder[/size]
[size=4]2.) Open the Animals folder[/size]
[size=4]3.) Back up the original cat.xnb file (rename it, if you would like)[/size]
[size=4]4.) Drag in the new file[/size]

[font=Times New Roman][b][size=4]Instructions to find the Stardew Valley Content Folder (for newbies)[/size]
[/b][/font][size=4]1.) Open Steam[/size]
[size=4]2.) Right click on the Stardew Valley label (located on the game selection box to the left of your screen)[/size]
[size=4]3.) Click on Properties then navigate to the tab with Local Files[/size]
[size=4]4.) Click Browse Local Files[/size]
[size=4]5.) Contents/Resources/Content[/size]

Downloads.Description: Colors your default game cat a beautiful, pure, milky white
